pages.title: The Sixteen Eyes
pages.text: $(bold)The End portal needs sixteen different eyes. None can be mined or crafted: each drops from something that has to be killed.$(br2)Every eye is a node on the last ring, $(thing)28 Focal Shards$(n) each, all behind the final seal.

pages.title: You Cannot Waste One
pages.text: $(bold)A boss takes no damage from you until the node that asks for it is reachable, so you cannot kill one early and lose the drop.$(br2)Once it is reachable, the kill counts and the eye drops. An eye you have not yet unlocked still goes in your pack; it just will not go in the portal frame.

pages.title: What Carries Them
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)A pirate captain$(n): rogue eye, 34% of the time$(br)$(thing)Helvar$(n): cursed eye$(br)$(thing)Skor$(n): cold eye$(br)$(thing)Sirok$(n): old eye$(br)$(thing)Nerakyss$(n): guardian eye$(br)$(thing)The Ashlord$(n): nether eye
